entities.name: Samuel Wendell Williston
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Samuel Wendell Williston was an American educator, entomologist, and paleontologist who was the first to propose that birds developed flight cursorially, rather than arboreally. He was a specialist on the flies, Diptera.
